partners.diseaseBName: mitochondrial myopathy, episodic, with optic atrophy and reversible leukoencephalopathy
partners.mechanism_chain: CYP11A1 (HGNC:2474) —DISRUPTS→ Steroidogenesis intermediates (CHEBI:33633); Steroidogenesis intermediates (CHEBI:33633) —DECREASES→ Mitochondrial respiration (GO:0045333); FDX2 (HGNC:3719) —DISRUPTS→ Mitochondrial respiration (GO:0045333); Mitochondrial respiration (GO:0045333) —LEADS_TO→ Mitochondrial myopathy (HP:0003198); Mitochondrial respiration (GO:0045333) —LEADS_TO→ Optic atrophy (HP:0000648); Mitochondrial respiration (GO:0045333) —LEADS_TO→ Leukoencephalopathy (HP:0002374). Loss-of-function mutations in CYP11A1 are hypothesized to disrupt steroidogenesis, indirectly impacting mitochondrial respiration. Concurrently, loss-of-function mutations in FDX2 directly impair mitochondrial respiration. Both disruptions converge on compromised mitochondrial function, leading to the shared phenotypes of myopathy, optic atrophy, and leukoencephalopathy.

partners.diseaseBName: congenital lipoid adrenal hyperplasia due to STAR deficency
partners.mechanism_chain: STAR (HGNC:11108) —DISRUPTS→ Steroidogenesis (REACT:R-HSA-1435704); Cholesterol (CHEBI:15360) —BINDS→ Steroidogenesis (REACT:R-HSA-1435704); Steroidogenesis (REACT:R-HSA-1435704) —LEADS_TO→ Adrenal insufficiency (HP:0000750); CYP11A1 (HGNC:2470) —DISRUPTS→ Steroidogenesis (REACT:R-HSA-1435704); Steroidogenesis (REACT:R-HSA-1435704) —LEADS_TO→ Congenital adrenal hyperplasia (HP:0000751). Mutations in STAR (MONDO:0008725) directly impair the transport of cholesterol into mitochondria, disrupting steroidogenesis and leading to adrenal insufficiency. falsification.text: If pathogenic variants in STAR are identified in patients with MONDO:0013400, or conversely, if pathogenic variants in CYP11A1 are identified as the primary cause for MONDO:0008725, this would suggest a direct causal link rather than a convergent module overlap.
